RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  July 28, 2010/Sravana 6, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
13
Meeting of intelligence chiefs of India
and Pakistan
*41. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  chiefs of intelligence
agencies of India and Pakistan held a meeting
as a part of the cooperation to fight
terrorism and dealt with security issues;
and
(b) whether according to a Minister of
Pakistan, both India and Pakistan have
agreed that  the agencies of two countries
would be working together to prevent any
repeat of Mumbai attack?
IAF crashes due to human error
*42. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Min ister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has admitted
that a large number of IAF crashes have
taken place due to human error;
(b) if so, whether Government has since
contemplated any steps to provide
adequate training to pilots to check such
IAF crashes; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Revamping of Rashtriya Swasthya
Bima Yojana
*43. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is in the process of revamping the Rashtriya
Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) so as to
extend the same to unorganized sector;
(b) if so, the details of the proposed
change;
(c) whether Government is planning to
add more categories like autorickshaw and
taxi drivers, rag pickers, etc., under RSBY;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

14
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Establishment of a solar plant near
Air-Force training base in
Jaisalmer
†*44. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that a
private company of Uttar Pradesh is going
to set up a solar plant within one kilometer
range of Chandhan training and firing range
for vital fighter aircrafts of Air Force in
Jaisalmer;
(b) whether Government proposes to
acquire the land purchased by the company
near such a vital military base; and
(c) whether permission has been
obtained from  the  Ministry  to set up this
plant before allotment of this land?
Foreign capital investment in retail
market
†*45. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal is
being considered by Government to give
foreign capital investment a free access to
the retail market of the country;
(b) if so, the outlines of the proposal;
(c) whether there is any compulsion on
the part of Government to permit foreign
capital investment in the retail market of
the country; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard  and
the reasons for this compulsion?
SAARC Home Ministers meet
*46. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether meeting of South Asian
Association for Regional Co-operation
(SAARC) Home Ministers attended by
Home Minister in the last week of June,
2010 resulted in positive development
which will push Pakistan to address terror,
including legal framework under which India
can demand handing over of persons like
LeT founder Hafiz Saeed in the absence of
an extradition treaty;
(b) if so, whether India has managed to
get Abu Salem from Portugal as both nations
were party to UN Convention for the
suppression of terrorist bombings; and
(c) if so, to what extent this SAARC
meeting has helped India for extradition of
people involved in terrorist activities in
India?
Need to overhaul anti-naxal strategy
*47. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether lack  of coordination
between the State Police and Central
Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has led to a
rise in attacks by naxalites in the past few
months;
(b) if so, whether the anti-naxal strategy
needs immediate overhaul;
(c) if so, whether the Union Government
has recently asked the naxal-affected States,
particularly Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand,
to follow Andhra Model to counter
naxalites; and
(d) if so, the reaction of the naxal-
affected States?

15
Naxalite movement gaining
momentum
*48. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that naxalites
movement has been gaining momentum in
West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, Bihar,
Jharkhand etc. and  naxals have been
targetting  security forces by killing them,
keeping them in captivity and snatching
their fire arms;
(b) if so, the details thereof and major
incidents of the last two years;
(c) the number of incidents with details
of cases in which naxalites freed their
members from the custody of police; and
(d) what Government has done to boost
the morale of security forces in their fight
against naxalites?
Amarnath Yatra
*49. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Annual
Amarnath Y atra in Kashmir V alley began
this year amid great tension and heavy
deployment of security forces after being
halted in Jammu;
(b) whether it is also a fact that some
terrorist groups wanted to reduce the
period of Amarnath Yatra from two months
to fifteen days; and
(c) if so, the detail of the preventive
measures taken by Government for safety
of thousands of determined pilgrims who
are required to pass through many troubled
parts of the Kashmir Valley before reaching
the Holy Shrine?
Cases of honour killings
*50. SHRI PRAKASH JA V ADEKAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been a rise in cases of honour killings in the
recent past;
(b) if so, the number of people killed in
this manner; and
(c) what action Government is
contemplating to stop this practice of
honour killings?
Agreement    with    Russia
for development of fifth
generation fighter jets
†*51. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has signed
agreement with Russia for jointly
developing fifth generation fighter jets;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the conditions of agreement with
regard to foreign investment limit in this
project?
Pending proposals for widening the
NHs in A.P.
*52. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether some States are awaiting
clarification from the Ministry on the
proposals for widening the national
highways passing through the States
especially Andhra Pradesh;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

16
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last five years where the cases are pending
with the Ministry, State-wise;
(c) by when the clearances will be given
to each proposal; and
(d) the reasons for keeping the
proposals pending?
Naxalites extending their activities to
Punjab
*53. SHRI H.K. DUA: Will the Minister
of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the press reports about the
naxalites extending their activities to Punjab
are correct;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
tackle the situation;
(c) whether State Government has asked
for special Central assistance in this
connection; and
(d) whether the naxalites have developed
any links with some terrorist groups in the
State?
Gender bias in army
*54. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware about
the fact that even after Delhi High Court
order, gender bias still continues in the army;
and
(b) if so, what steps Government has
taken to implement the Delhi High Court
order?
Killing of CRPF personnel due to
ignorance of intelligence reports
†*55. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that had
Chhattisgarh Government not ignored the
intelligence reports, the naxalites would not
have killed 26 CRPF personnel on 29 June,
2010;
(b) whether it is also a fact that State
Government ignored the intelligence reports
and the demand of Narayanpur Police
regarding establishing a CRPF camp at
Narayanpur; and
(c) whether Government proposes to
get lapses that led to killing of CRPF
personnel by the naxalites on 29 June, 2010
investigated?
Increase in naxal incidents despite
Government drives against them
†*56. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of army personnel, police
personnel and villagers killed by the
naxalites in the country during the last three
years;
(b) the number of naxalites arrested or
killed in encounters in the country during
the last three years;
(c) the quantum of damage caused to
Government property by the naxalites
during the same period; and
(d) whether  there has been increase in
naxal incidents year after year despite
Government's drives against them, during
the last three years?

17
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Special courts for early disposal of
maoists/naxalites related cases
†*57. SHRI MOHAN SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the total number of maoists/naxalites
arrested in various encounters in Orissa,
Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal and
Chhattisgarh during  the last two years;
(b) the number of those tried under
various sections;
(c) the number of cases decided by lower
courts that had been filed under various
sections against them is these States;
(d) the number of maoists/naxalites
imprisoned for life or sentenced to death;
(e) whether Government is considering
setting up special courts for early disposal
of cases related to maoists/naxalites; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Orissa hardest hit by naxal problem
†*58. SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Orissa is
hardest hit by the naxal problem;
(b) whether it is also a fact that these
days, more incidents of naxalite attacks and
violence are taking place in this State as
compared to other States of the country;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps being taken by Government to resolve
this issue;
(d) whether State Government has been
unable to tackle this problem;and
(e) if so, the options available with
Government to provide security to the poor
people of the State?
Robbers and thiefs arrested at Delhi
Airport
*59. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Central
Industrial Security Force (CISF) has
arrested some people for robberies and
thefts at Delhi Airport on July 5, 2010;
(b)  the details of such thefts and the
number of robbers apprehended by the
CISF in 2009-2010 and in the current fiscal
year;
(c) whether CISF has not properly
monitored all areas of the airports;
(d) whether CISF has not been
functioning at peak efficiency at our
airports;
(e) whether CCTVs will be installed to
carefully monitor how the CISF personnel
conduct themselves at airport at all times;
and
(f) the steps proposed to install CCTVs
at all points where CISF personnel have
been deployed like screening areas, etc.?
Availability of foreign arms  with
insurgent groups in NER
*60. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether reports of foreign arms being
carried by insurgent groups in the North-
Eastern Region (NER)  are true;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
number of cases reported, arms seized and
the foreign country from where supply has
been identified during the last three years,
including 2010;

18
(c) whether Ministry has received
representations from the State
Governments of NER in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details of steps taken by
Government to check the availability
of foreign arms in NER and high level
dialogue/talks with the country in this
matter?
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 22nd July, 2010 Secretary-General.
Asadha 31, 1932 (Saka)
